dslRule:
<!id: lambda.methodRef.this>
<!description: Replaces lambda 'p -> this.method(p)' with method reference 'this::method'.
This applies when the lambda's body is a single method call on the enclosing instance, with the lambda's parameter as the sole argument to that method.>
<!severity: HINT>
$receiver.$method($lambdaParam -> $methodInBody($lambdaParam)) :: sourceVersionGE(8)
=> $receiver.$method(this::$methodInBody)
;;
summary: Convert a lambda `param -> this.method(param)` to a `this::method` method reference when passed as an argument.

verification.message: Candidate DSL must contain only one rule and optional per-rule metadata; file metadata, includes, and embedded Java are not promotable
